incidents.title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Starvation & Cascade Timeouts
incidents.representativeMessage: Database connection pool exhausted: 100/100 active connections in checkout-db pool

rootCauseAnalysis.summary: Checkout DB max connections reached due to unindexed query lock in order-processor, creating cascade 504s across dependent microservices.
rootCauseAnalysis.probableRootCause: PostgreSQL connection starvation on primary replica (pool size=100 reached).
rootCauseAnalysis.recommendedAction: Scale connection pool with PgBouncer or terminate slow long-running transaction PID 48210.

agentTrace.decisionExplanation: Multiple microservices throwing connection timeout variants across same database cluster within 30s window.

incidents.title: Stripe Payment Gateway 504 Gateway Timeout Rate Spike
incidents.representativeMessage: Stripe API Error (POST /v1/payment_intents): Request timed out after 30000ms

rootCauseAnalysis.summary: Upstream third-party payment provider experiencing elevated latencies on US-East webhook ingress.
rootCauseAnalysis.probableRootCause: Third-party Stripe API webhook & intent creation degradation.
rootCauseAnalysis.recommendedAction: Enable fallback payment retry queue and display degraded checkout warning.

agentTrace.decisionExplanation: Grouped 68 alerts from billing and subscriptions referencing Stripe intent timeouts.

incidents.title: Redis Cluster Memory Pressure & Eviction Cascade
incidents.representativeMessage: OOM command not allowed when used memory > maxmemory on session-cache-02

rootCauseAnalysis.summary: Redis session cache cluster hit 100% maxmemory policy (noeviction configured on replica), causing auth session token lookup failures.
rootCauseAnalysis.probableRootCause: Session TTL expiry key leakage during campaign launch.
rootCauseAnalysis.recommendedAction: Flushed expired session prefixes and updated eviction policy to volatile-lru.

agentTrace.decisionExplanation: Repeated identical Redis OOM signature across session gateway nodes.
